_status: DRAFT - Yenna reviews the advice text.
_how_to_read: status_to_level maps a region status to an advice level. A yellow region becomes 'crew' when at least crew_if_regions_yellow regions are yellow or worse. The environment changes the advice text, never the level. extra_steps adds a ladder step for one location (shown only, never an advice level): it sits after the level in `after`.

advice.default: Look after it yourself: rest, drink, exercise as planned, and repeat the check tomorrow.
Tell a crewmate today so someone else is watching this with you.
Report this at your next planned contact with the flight surgeon.
advice.iss: Report this at your next planned contact with the flight surgeon. The link is live, so you can also call sooner.
advice.moon: Report this at your next planned contact with the flight surgeon. Expect a short delay in the conversation.
advice.mars: Send a message to the flight surgeon today. It takes several minutes to arrive, and the reply takes as long to come back.

advice.iss: Call the flight surgeon now. The link is live.
advice.moon: Call the flight surgeon now. Expect a delay of about a second each way.
advice.mars: Act now with your crew using the protocol; your message to the flight surgeon is sent and arrives in several minutes.

mars.pill: Flight surgeon link: several minutes delay
mars.sent: Sent. Arrives in several minutes. Reply in roughly double that. Keep following the protocol.

link.reply_placeholder: PLACEHOLDER REPLY (simulated): Flight surgeon here. Message received. Keep following the protocol and send the vitals again in 5 minutes.
